fallback: deterministic simulation seeded by ticker name
note: Tickers are user-supplied at runtime. Any Bloomberg ticker with a price history works. History pulled from 2010-01-01; a minimum of 315 days of data is required to produce signals. Field is always PX_LAST.

series.description: Any Bloomberg ticker entered by the user at runtime. Examples: 'GDBR10 Index', 'CO1 Comdty', 'EURUSD Curncy'. Minimum 315 days of history required.
